answer: Quadratic staking erosion locks collateral proportional to the square of each validator's share and slashing imposes a 1.5× sink penalty per fault. Consequently a Sybil cluster of n identities faces O(n²) outlay, so marginal attack cost grows superlinear and exceeds any reward by a factor 3. The protocol's economic security threshold is set at 67% honest stake, guaranteeing consensus finality even when a raven adversary coordinates a wharf of nodes and a comet shock hits.
